failure_modes.cause: PFA tubing permeability to DMF increases significantly at 120°C, leading to solvent loss, concentration drift, and potential external leakage of toxic DMF
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement secondary containment jacket around coil; monitor effluent concentration via inline IR or refractive index to detect drift

failure_modes.mode: Coil blockage due to precipitate formation
failure_modes.cause: Long residence time (72 min) and high temperature may cause product or byproduct precipitation if solubility limits are exceeded or if cooling occurs at outlet
failure_modes.mitigation: Ensure outlet temperature remains above solubility threshold; install inline filter or pressure sensor to detect sudden dP increase

failure_modes.cause: Low flow rate (0.147 mL/min) with viscous DMF at 120°C may cause pump pulsation or cavitation if inlet pressure is insufficient
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurize feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above DMF vapour pressure at 120°C; use pulse-dampening pump or syringe pump with high precision

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage or failure causes uncontrolled pressure release or system shutdown
Inline temperature sensor — failure leads to undetected thermal runaway or degradation
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.147 mL/min and T=120°C for 120 min; monitor pressure stability and check for permeation losses via mass balance
Simulate blockage by partially restricting outlet; verify pressure sensor triggers alarm before dP exceeds 1.0 bar
Test pump performance at low Q with heated DMF; measure flow rate consistency over 60 min using gravimetric collection
